modal.help_s1b: Chinja Madraivha emavhoriyamu ese, + Wedzera folda kuwedzera, x inobvisa rimwe, kanaisa nzira dzakapatsanurwa na `;` muEdit. Kuchinja matabhu kunochinja mafolda.
modal.help_s2b: Zita, Regex (Rust syntax), Fuzzy, Mukati mefaira, Glob (*.rs), Chese (OR) / Hapana che (NOT), masaizi (mabhaiti kana 10M/1G), mazuva (YYYY-MM-DD), rondedzero yekusvetuka yeExclude, Mawedzero kana group chips (tsiva, dzvanya zvakare kubvisa; Manage inogadzirisa etsika), Regeredza case, Ratidza zvakavanzwa.
modal.help_s3b: Bhatani guru reScan & search kana Enter. Refresh inomhanyazve ichichengetedza sarudzo. Live inomhanyazve magadzirirwo (yakadzima by default). Tsvagiridzo dzisina chinhu hadzimhanyi — isa * muGlob pane zvese.
modal.help_s4b: Misoro midiki inoronga, Go inosvetukira mapeji, checkboxes dzinopa Copy paths / Move / Delete uye maexports eCSV–TXT–HTML–Excel–RTF. Tsvagiridzo dzakachengetwa neRecent snapshots dzinodzosa sefa dzese kusanganisira mafolda, OR/NOT, uye zvakavanzwa.
modal.help_keys_body: Enter inotsvaga · Esc inobvisa focus / inovhara dialogs · ↑/↓ inofambisa sarudzo · Space inotara mutsara · Tab inofamba pakati pezvinodzora.
